extDescription.message: Na'urorin lissafin kasuwanci don ROI, kudin hannu, wurin daidaito, NPV, IRR da ƙari. Duk lissafi na faruwa a na'urarka.

resultUndefinedHint.message: Ba a ayyana wannan sakamakon ga waɗannan ƙimomin ba, misali lokacin raba da sifili ko idan babu amsa.

statusCopyFailed.message: Ba a iya kwafi zuwa allon ɗauka ba.

statusSaveFailed.message: Ba a iya adana saitunanka ba.

footer.message: Lissafin na faruwa a na'urarka; abin da ka rubuta ba a aika shi ko'ina. Ƙiyasi ne, ba shawarar kuɗi ba.

seriesHint.message: Ƙima ɗaya a kowane layi (ko raba da ɗigon waƙafi). Yi amfani da alamar debewa ga kuɗaɗen da ke fita.

decimalsLabel.message: Wuraren ɓangaren ƙidaya don kashi-kashi da rabo

rememberInputsLabel.message: Tuna abin da na rubuta muddin burauza a buɗe take

rememberInputsHint.message: Yana zama a ƙwaƙwalwar burauza kawai kuma yana gogewa idan an rufe Chrome. Kashe shi yana goge shi nan take.

errorMax.message: Dole ya zama bai wuce $VALUE$ ba.

errorTooManyEntries.message: Shigar da ƙimomi bai wuce $COUNT$ ba.

errorInvalidEntry.message: Shigarwa ta $POSITION$ ba lamba mai inganci ba ce.

group_liquidity.message: Kuɗin hannu da ikon biyan bashi

group_investment.message: Zuba jari da samar da kuɗi

calc_roi_desc.message: Nawa jari ya samu ko ya yi asara idan aka kwatanta da kuɗin da aka saka.

calc_roi_formula.message: ROI = (abin da aka dawo da shi − jari) ÷ jari

field_roi_returned.message: Kuɗin da aka dawo da shi

calc_cagr_name.message: Ƙimar haɓaka ta shekara-shekara mai tarawa (CAGR)

calc_cagr_desc.message: Tsayayyar ƙimar haɓaka ta shekara da ke kai ƙima daga farko zuwa ƙarshe.

calc_roe_name.message: Riba kan hannun jari da kadarori (ROE, ROA)

calc_roe_desc.message: Nawa riba kamfani ke samu daga hannun jarin masu hannun jari da kadarorinsa.

calc_roe_formula.message: ROE = kuɗin shiga na gaske ÷ hannun jari · ROA = kuɗin shiga na gaske ÷ kadarori

calc_margin_desc.message: Riba a matsayin kaso na farashin sayarwa (rata) da na kuɗin da aka kashe (ƙari).

calc_margin_formula.message: Rata = (farashi − kuɗin kashewa) ÷ farashi · Ƙari = (farashi − kuɗin kashewa) ÷ kuɗin kashewa

calc_pricing_name.message: Farashi don ratar da ake nufi

calc_pricing_desc.message: Farashin sayarwa da ke ba da ratar da kake so da ƙarin da ake buƙata don hakan.

calc_pricing_formula.message: Farashi = kuɗin kashewa ÷ (1 − rata) · Ƙari = rata ÷ (1 − rata)

calc_breakeven_desc.message: Yankuna nawa za a sayar don rufe kuɗaɗen kashewa na dindindin kuma a kai ga burin riba idan akwai.

calc_breakeven_formula.message: Yankuna = (kuɗaɗen dindindin + ribar da ake nufi) ÷ (farashi − kuɗin kashewa mai canjawa)

field_breakeven_variableCost.message: Kuɗin kashewa mai canjawa na kowane yanki

calc_liquidity_desc.message: Ko kamfani zai iya biyan bashin gajeren lokaci da kadarorinsa na gajeren lokaci.

calc_liquidity_formula.message: Na yanzu = kadarorin yanzu ÷ basussukan yanzu · Gaggawa = (kuɗi + abin da za a karɓa) ÷ basussukan yanzu · Kuɗi = kuɗi ÷ basussukan yanzu

calc_cashCycle_desc.message: Kwanaki nawa kuɗi ke makalewa tsakanin biyan masu kawo kaya da karɓa daga abokan ciniki.

calc_cashCycle_formula.message: CCC = kwanakin kayan ajiya + kwanakin karɓa − kwanakin biya

field_cashCycle_receivables.message: Matsakaicin abin da za a karɓa

field_cashCycle_payables.message: Matsakaicin abin da za a biya

calc_leverage_desc.message: Yadda kamfani ya dogara da bashi da yadda kuɗin shigarsa ke rufe ruwan bashi cikin sauƙi.

calc_leverage_formula.message: Bashi/hannun jari = bashi ÷ hannun jari · Bashi/jari = bashi ÷ (bashi + hannun jari) · Rufewa = EBIT ÷ ruwa

calc_investment_desc.message: Shin aikin yana da amfani? Yana rage darajar kwararar kuɗi ta nan gaba kuma yana gano lokacin da za a dawo da kuɗin.

calc_investment_formula.message: NPV = Σ CFₜ ÷ (1 + r)ᵗ − jari · IRR: ƙimar da NPV = 0

calc_futureValue_desc.message: Yadda wani adadi ke girma da ruwa mai tarawa tare da ajiya na yau da kullum.

calc_futureValue_formula.message: FV = PV × (1 + i)ⁿ + ajiya × ((1 + i)ⁿ − 1) ÷ i, inda i = ƙimar shekara ÷ lokuta a shekara

calc_loan_desc.message: Kuɗin biyan bashi na wata-wata da jimillar ruwan da ake biya.

calc_loan_formula.message: Kuɗin biya = asali × i ÷ (1 − (1 + i)⁻ⁿ), inda i = ƙimar shekara ÷ 12

marketOff.message: Ana iya cika ƙimar ruwan manufofin Brazil (Selic) da farashin dala daga babban bankin Brazil.

marketFailed.message: Ba a iya isa ga babban banki ba. Duba haɗinka.

statusMarketPermissionDenied.message: Ba a ba da izini ba, don haka ba a ɗauko wata ƙima ba.

liveRatesLabel.message: Ɗauko ƙimar ruwan manufofin Brazil (Selic) da farashin dala daga babban bankin Brazil

liveRatesHint.message: A kashe yake ta asali. Idan ka kunna, Chrome zai nemi izinin haɗawa da api.bcb.gov.br, wanda ba ya karɓar wani bayani game da kai. Kashewa yana janye izinin.

calc_selicYield_name.message: Kuɗin shiga tsayayye da ke da alaƙa da ƙimar manufofi (Selic, CDB)

calc_selicYield_desc.message: Nawa jarin da ke biyan kaso na ƙimar ruwan manufofin babban banki (Selic a Brazil, MPR na CBN a Najeriya) zai bayar bayan harajin kuɗin shiga.

calc_selicYield_formula.message: Ribar gaske = adadi × (haɓaka − 1) × (1 − harajin kuɗin shiga); haɓakar na tarawa kowace rana a kwanakin aiki 252 na shekara

field_selicYield_percentOfRate.message: Kason ƙimar manufofi da ake biya

choice_selicYield_taxTreatment_1.message: Teburin haraji mai raguwa (CDB, takardar gwamnati)

calc_savings_name.message: Asusun ajiya (poupança) da jari mai alaƙa da ƙimar manufofi

calc_savings_desc.message: Yana kwatanta asusun ajiya (poupança) da kayan kuɗin shiga tsayayye mai haraji, kuma yana gano kason ƙimar manufofi da ake daidaita su.

calc_savings_formula.message: Ajiya: 0.5% a wata idan Selic ya wuce 8.5%, in ba haka ba 70% na Selic. Kuɗin shiga tsayayye yana da harajin kuɗin shiga mai raguwa

field_savings_percentOfRate.message: Kason ƙimar manufofi da ake biya (kuɗin shiga tsayayye)

out_savings_fixedIncomeFinal.message: Kuɗin shiga tsayayye a ƙarshe (na gaske)

calc_dollarConversion_desc.message: Dala nawa za ka samu da reais ɗinka bayan lissafin bambancin banki da harajin musayar kuɗi na IOF.

out_dollarConversion_costPercent.message: Kuɗin a matsayin kaso na adadin

calc_dollarVsSelic_desc.message: A ina dala ya kamata ya kasance a ƙarshe don riƙe dala ya doke ƙimar manufofi (Selic)? Kwatanta ne da jimillar adadi kafin harajin kuɗin shiga.

calc_dollarVsSelic_formula.message: Dala na daidaito = sakamakon ƙimar manufofi ÷ dala da aka riƙe a ƙarshe

field_dollarVsSelic_expected.message: Dalar da ake tsammani a ƙarshe

field_dollarVsSelic_usdYield.message: Riba kan dala (a shekara, a US$)

out_dollarVsSelic_selicFinal.message: Jarin ƙimar manufofi a ƙarshe (kafin haraji)

ratingLegend.message: Kore: mai kyau · Na yau da kullum: tsaka-tsaki · Ja: mara kyau

ratingRuleHigher.message: Ƙasa da $BAD$: mara kyau · Daga $BAD$ zuwa $GOOD$: tsaka-tsaki · Sama da $GOOD$: mai kyau

ratingRuleLower.message: Sama da $BAD$: mara kyau · Daga $GOOD$ zuwa $BAD$: tsaka-tsaki · Ƙasa da $GOOD$: mai kyau

ratingRuleSplitHigher.message: Ƙasa da $VALUE$: mara kyau · A $VALUE$: tsaka-tsaki · Sama da $VALUE$: mai kyau

ratingRuleSplitLower.message: Sama da $VALUE$: mara kyau · A $VALUE$: tsaka-tsaki · Ƙasa da $VALUE$: mai kyau

ratingDisclaimer.message: Ƙa'idar zahiri: abin da ke da lafiya ya bambanta bisa ga masana'anta.

calc_incomeStatement_desc.message: Yana tafiya daga kuɗin shiga zuwa kuɗin shiga na gaske kuma yana nuna rata a kowane mataki.

calc_incomeStatement_formula.message: EBITDA = kuɗin shiga − kuɗin sayarwa − kuɗaɗen aiki · EBIT = EBITDA − lalacewar daraja · Na gaske = (EBIT − ruwa) × (1 − haraji)

calc_dupont_desc.message: Yana rarraba riba kan hannun jari zuwa rata, jujjuyawar kadarori da nauyin bashi.

calc_dupont_formula.message: ROE = ratar gaske × jujjuyawar kadarori × ninkin hannun jari

calc_dupont5_desc.message: Yana rarraba ROE zuwa nauyin haraji, nauyin ruwa, ratar aiki, jujjuyawar kadarori da nauyin bashi.

calc_dupont5_formula.message: ROE = (K.G ÷ EBT) × (EBT ÷ EBIT) × (EBIT ÷ kuɗin shiga) × (kuɗin shiga ÷ kadarori) × (kadarori ÷ hannun jari)

calc_fleuriet_desc.message: Yana rarraba tsarin kuɗi bisa jarin aiki (CDG), bukatarsa (NCG) da ragowar kuɗi (T).

calc_fleuriet_formula.message: CDG = kuɗaɗen dindindin − kadarori marasa yanzu · NCG = kadarorin yanzu na aiki − basussukan yanzu na aiki · T = CDG − NCG

cat_fleuriet_structureType_1.message: Nau'i na I – Mai kyau ƙwarai

cat_fleuriet_structureType_3.message: Nau'i na III – Ba mai gamsarwa ba

cat_fleuriet_structureType_5.message: Nau'i na V – Mara kyau ƙwarai

cat_fleuriet_structureType_6.message: Nau'i na VI – Haɗari mai yawa

calc_altman_desc.message: Yana auna haɗarin matsalar kuɗi daga rabo biyar na takardar kadarori da kuɗin shiga, a nau'i biyu.

calc_leverageDegrees_name.message: Matakin nauyin aiki da na kuɗi

calc_leverageDegrees_desc.message: Yadda canjin tallace-tallace ke motsa ribar aiki da ribar bayan ruwa.

calc_leverageDegrees_formula.message: DOL = ratar gudummawa ÷ EBIT · DFL = EBIT ÷ (EBIT − ruwa) · DTL = DOL × DFL

calc_depreciation_desc.message: Lalacewar darajar kadara a shekara, jimillar lalacewar daraja da darajar littafi, ta hanyoyi uku.

calc_depreciation_formula.message: Madaidaiciya = (kuɗin kashewa − ragowa) ÷ rayuwa · Ragowa mai raguwa = darajar littafi × 2 ÷ rayuwa · Jimillar lambobin shekaru = (kuɗin kashewa − ragowa) × sauran rayuwa ÷ Σ shekaru

calc_wacc_desc.message: Matsakaicin kuɗin samar da kuɗin kamfani, daga kuɗin hannun jari na CAPM da kuɗin bashi bayan haraji.

calc_wacc_formula.message: Ke = Rf + β × ƙarin haɗari · WACC = E ÷ (D + E) × Ke + D ÷ (D + E) × Kd × (1 − haraji)

calc_eva_desc.message: Ko kasuwanci yana samun fiye da kuɗin jarin da aka zuba a ciki.

calc_eva_formula.message: EVA = NOPAT − WACC × jarin da aka zuba · NOPAT = EBIT × (1 − haraji) · ROIC = NOPAT ÷ jarin da aka zuba

out_eva_roic.message: Riba kan jarin da aka zuba (ROIC)

calc_freeCashFlow_desc.message: Kuɗin da ya rage bayan aiki da zuba jari: ga duk masu ba da jari (FCFF) da masu hannun jari (FCFE).

calc_freeCashFlow_formula.message: FCFF = EBIT × (1 − haraji) + lalacewar daraja − CapEx − ΔNWC · FCFE = FCFF − ruwa × (1 − haraji) + bashin gaske

field_freeCashFlow_netBorrowing.message: Bashin da aka ci na gaske

out_freeCashFlow_fcfe.message: Kwararar kuɗi kyauta ta masu hannun jari (FCFE)

calc_bond_name.message: Farashin takardar bashi da tsawon lokaci

calc_bond_desc.message: Farashin takardar bashi mai kuɗin ruwa, ƙarinta ko rage darajarta da yadda take kula da riba.

calc_bond_formula.message: Farashi = Σ kuɗin ruwa ÷ (1 + y)ᵗ + darajar fuska ÷ (1 + y)ⁿ · Tsawon lokaci da aka gyara = Macaulay ÷ (1 + y)

field_bond_yieldToMaturity.message: Riba har zuwa cikar wa'adi (a shekara)

calc_rates_name.message: Sauya ƙimar ruwa da ƙimar gaskiya

calc_rates_desc.message: Yana sauya ƙimar suna zuwa ta gaske, ta wata da ta rana, sannan ya cire hauhawar farashi don samun ƙimar gaskiya.

calc_rates_formula.message: Ta gaske = (1 + ta suna ÷ m)ᵐ − 1 · Makamanci = (1 + ta gaske)^(1 ÷ n) − 1 · Ta gaskiya = (1 + ta gaske) ÷ (1 + hauhawa) − 1

calc_amortization_desc.message: Yana kwatanta hanyoyin biyan bashi biyu: a Price kuɗin biya daidai suke, a SAC ana biyan kaso ɗaya na asali kowane wata.

calc_amortization_formula.message: Price = P × i ÷ (1 − (1 + i)⁻ⁿ) · SAC = P ÷ n + ragowar bashi × i, inda i = ƙimar shekara ÷ 12
